name: backend
description: API REST de Notium en Nest.js

scripts.migration:generate: nest build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/typeorm/cli.js -d dist/database/data-source.js migration:generate --esm
scripts.migration:run: nest build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/typeorm/cli.js -d dist/database/data-source.js migration:run
scripts.migration:revert: nest build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/typeorm/cli.js -d dist/database/data-source.js migration:revert
scripts.migration:show: nest build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/typeorm/cli.js -d dist/database/data-source.js migration:show
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build
